hero.intro: Member of Technical Staff at SurveySparrow, working on core platform and mobile SDKs. Two published papers in applied machine learning. Starting an *MSc in Advanced Artificial Intelligence* at University College Dublin.

items.title: Detection of Signs of Depression using Social Media Text
items.description: A machine learning and deep learning pipeline using BERT, RoBERTa, CNN and SVM for mental health detection. Ranked **12th globally** in LT-EDI@RANLP 2023, hosted on CodaLab.

items.title: Ensemble-Based Attrition Prediction in Corporate Settings
items.description: A predictive model for employee attrition combining advanced feature selection, SMOTE, XGBoost, CatBoost and Gated Recurrent Units. Published as a Springer book chapter in the proceedings of the 4th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Smart Energy.

bullets: Re-architected the Bulk Response Creation API, achieving a **10× performance improvement**, and revamped the Response Import application for scalability and processing efficiency.
Built AMP Email Surveys, enabling users to complete surveys directly inside email clients.
Owned and maintained all mobile SDKs: iOS in SwiftUI and UIKit, Android in Kotlin Jetpack Compose and Java, and cross-platform parity across Flutter, React Native and Ionic.

Built and integrated iOS CI/CD pipelines using Codemagic, upgraded React Native to the latest stable release, implemented the Google Play Integrity API for Android security, and integrated Google OAuth 2.0 with Expo.
Delivered time-sensitive features for high-priority clients and supported AppNest initiatives through feature delivery, deployment and integration.

items.description: Full-stack work across React Native, Flutter, Kotlin, Swift, Node.js (Hapi.js) and PostgreSQL. Shipped feature enhancements and bug fixes on mobile and web under senior mentorship, and worked with the product team on real-world use cases, debugging practices and agile development.
Built cross-platform mobile applications in Flutter with Firebase integration for authentication and real-time data handling.

items.title: KEC Connect

items.title: Flutter Workshop — KPR Institute of Engineering & Technology

items.title: Becoming an Interview Pro — Kongu Engineering College
items.description: Guided 250+ students on interview preparation, attitude grooming and real-world insights.

items.title: Dynamic Programming Seminar — Dept. of CT-PG
